verdict.rationale: Lovable is operated mainly through natural-language chat. Users describe what to build, and the agent generates apps, creates database schemas, adds auth, and runs project actions such as publishing and domain search from chat. The same natural-language interface is available through Slack, ChatGPT, Telegram, and an MCP server. Community users describe prompt-driven building, but none corroborates in depth that chat-driven project actions like publish or domain search work. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of chat-based project operations beyond app generation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: you describe what you want in the chat panel on the left, and you watch your app take shape in the preview on the right
you can also ask Lovable to run project actions from chat, for example publish my app, deploy this project, ship it, or find me a domain for my bakery
Describe the data your app needs in chat, and Lovable creates the tables and schema for you.
Ask Lovable to publish, deploy, ship, or go live, and it handles the deploy for you while respecting all publish-related workspace settings and permissions.
Mention @Lovable in a channel or send it a direct message to create new projects, make changes to existing ones, and ask questions about the apps in your workspace
